$comment: Wording layer. Contains NO card names and NO faction names — those live in the theme and are injected via tokens, so re-theming can never break another card's text. Tokens: {icon:<name>} inline glyph; {card:<id>} card name from the theme; {faction:<id>.<form>} faction label from the theme, where <form> is any form the theme defines (one, other, and for German also case forms).

effects.1.b: Move {icon:move} this card 1 space towards the center {term:path.of}.
effects.3.a: Send the lowest {icon:lowest} adjacent card to the beginning {term:path.of}.
effects.4.a: Move {icon:moveBack} the lowest {icon:lowest} adjacent card back 2 spaces.
effects.5.a: Swap {icon:swap} this card with a card up to 2 spaces away.
effects.6.a: Send the lowest {icon:lowest} adjacent card to the space before {card:2}.
effects.6.b: If it is {card:2}, move {icon:move} {card:2} 2 spaces towards {card:0}, even if it moves beyond it.
effects.7.a: Choose a card 3 spaces away and move {icon:move} it 1 space.
effects.7.b: Choose a card 2 spaces away and move {icon:move} it 2 spaces.
effects.7.c: Choose a card 1 space away and move {icon:move} it 3 spaces.
effects.8.a: Move {icon:moveBack} any adjacent card back 2 spaces.
effects.9.a: Swap {icon:swap} this card with a card 3 spaces away.
effects.10.a: Swap {icon:swap} this card with any adjacent card.
effects.11.a: Move {icon:move} the lowest {icon:lowest} adjacent card 2 spaces towards {card:2}, even if it moves beyond it.
effects.11.b: If it is {card:2}, move {icon:move} {card:2} 2 spaces towards {card:0}, even if it moves beyond it.
effects.13.a: Move {icon:moveBack} any adjacent card back 3 spaces.
effects.14.a: Swap {icon:swap} this card with a card 4 spaces away.

titleCard.credit: A fan re-theme of the solo microgame “The Path of the Priest”. Rules unchanged. Not for sale.

objective.title: Objective
body: Make your way along {term:path.indef} of 14 cards, made up of 8 {faction:true.other} and 6 {faction:fake.other}.
Take {card:0} from the beginning {term:path.of} to the end and connect with {card:D}.

sections.heading: End of the Game
items: You win if, at the end of the {faction:fake.other} turn, {card:0} is next to {card:D}.
You lose if {card:0} is destroyed, or if {faction:true.negNom} can be activated.

setup.title: Setup
items: Shuffle the 14 remaining cards and form {term:path.def} by placing them from left to right.

turn.title: How to Play
items: Player turn: choose {faction:true.anyAkk} {term:path.in} and resolve 1 effect on that card.
{faction:fake.other} turn: {faction:fake.eachNom} {term:path.in} is activated from lowest to highest:
Begin a new round with the player turn.

entries.text: Immediately to its left or right (1 space away).
Move in any direction (left or right).
Move directly to the indicated position.
Remove the card {term:path.from} and therefore from the game.
Card with the lowest number in its top left corner.

clarifications.title: Clarifications 1
items: You may activate {faction:true.sameAkk} in consecutive rounds.
A few {faction:true.other} have multiple effects. When activating them, choose only one effect and resolve it.
If you cannot activate {faction:true.negAkk}, you lose immediately.
When you activate {faction:fake.indefAkk}, resolve its top effect. If unable, the bottom effect offers an alternative. If neither can be resolved, ignore that card.

clarifications2.title: Clarifications 2
items: If the movement from an effect cannot be carried out completely, you can't resolve that effect.
The numbers of the effects are exact, unless preceded by "up to". Example: "up to 2" means 1 or 2.
No card can move back beyond the first position {term:path.of}.
No card can move beyond {card:D}. You need to move {card:0} exactly to the position on the left side of {card:D}.
